title: Announce first attainment of 100 percent exactly once
abstract: When a project, phase, milestone, task or feature first reaches 100 percent, show its completion and percentage once in the reporting conversation.

source.reference: Generalized project-management and strict-porting proposal; private drafting text not retained

scope_hints.trigger: an item first reaches completion during progress reporting

unresolved: Choose a stable marker recording that a completed item has already been announced.
remarks: Proposed atomic rule only. Group membership is non-normative; no processing, task creation, rule publication or application is authorized by intake.
